articles.availability_note: Later correction: the primary paper describes ONE fusion protein with THREE functional parts: a mitochondrial anchor, condensate assembler and RNA-binding domain. The frozen news-release brief and originals say three proteins. The tool preserves some recent RNA history, not a complete timeline. Demonstrated in cultured human cells; animal and cancer benefits remain future aims. Paper: October 21; ETH report: October 26. Later checks covered indexed paper excerpts and the PubMed abstract, not all methods. The paper reports physiology controls under tested conditions. Illustration is conceptual.

ARI is an advocacy organization. This proposal, reported October 26, builds on an earlier 2026 blueprint. Quarterly confidential filings and FOUR BUSINESS DAYS for material-change notices are proposed, not enacted. The earlier scope tests require BOTH 10^26 training FLOP and $100 million in aggregate AI-training spending over the prior year. Detailed fields need rulemaking. DOJ referrals, FOIA exemptions and whistleblower provisions are proposals. Statements about absent powers refer to this proposed scheme, not all existing government powers. Safety, costs, comparability and adoption remain open. Illustration is fictional. Superscripts may repeat in the rendered text capture; the proposed compute threshold is 10^26 FLOP.

ARI是倡议组织，非监管机构。提案于10月26日获报道，建立在2026年较早蓝图上。季度保密报告、重大变化后四个工作日通报皆属提议，尚未生效；提案本身并未创设机构或权力。10^26次训练浮点运算与过去一年累计一亿美元AI训练支出，是早期蓝图拟议的双门槛，非现行法律。细目需后续规则制定。司法部移送、FOIA豁免、举报机制皆是建议。“不存在的权力”等表述仅指此拟议制度，并非否认政府已有职权。安全性、成本、可比性及是否获采纳仍开放。插画为想象。 渲染数学上标可能在文字采集中重复；拟议算力门槛为10^26次浮点运算，以本说明为准。
